body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 7, 2026
Stablecoin market cap sits near $287-310B even as U.S. regulators missed the GENIUS Act's July 18 rule-finalization deadline, leaving issuers in limbo through August comment periods.
Stablecoin News
GENIUS Act rules miss deadline, stablecoin uncertainty extends

Treasury, OCC, Fed, FDIC and NCUA all missed the July 18 deadline to finalize implementing rules, leaving the $310B stablecoin market under an incomplete federal framework. Comment periods run into August (FDIC through Aug 4, five-agency CIP through Aug 21).
Western Union launches stablecoin-linked Visa card
Western Union and Rain unveiled Stablecard, pairing a USDPT stablecoin wallet with a Visa card so remittances arrive as stablecoins and spend instantly anywhere Visa is accepted.
Standard Chartered-backed HKDAP stablecoin rollout slips to August

Anchorpoint Financial pushed the public launch of its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP into August after missing Q2 and end-of-July targets, opting for a B2B2C distribution model via approved partners.
Tether's USDT stays locked out of the EU as Circle gains ground

USDT remains without MiCA authorization and stays delisted from major EU-regulated exchanges, while Circle's USDC and EURC are MiCA-passportable across all EU member states via its French EMI license.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit tops $130M

A five-year-old firmware flaw let attackers reconstruct Bitcoin seed keys, draining 1,800+ BTC across 5,200+ addresses since July 30 in multiple waves. Coinkite issued an emergency patch and urged anyone who generated a seed since March 2021 to migrate funds.
$35M drained in coordinated attacks on three protocols
AFX's Arbitrum bridge ($24.15M), the Verus-Ethereum bridge ($7.54M, its second hack this year) and B2's staking contract ($3.86M) were each hit within a six-hour window on July 22-23.
$290M Kelp DAO/LayerZero bridge hack sparked $9B Aave panic
The largest DeFi exploit of 2026 so far drained 116,500 rsETH from a LayerZero-built cross-chain bridge, triggering contagion fears that pushed investors to pull roughly $9B from Aave.
2026 crypto hack losses near $1.2B across 276 incidents
CertiK's mid-year tally shows fewer but far more surgical hacks in 2026, with attackers increasingly targeting admin keys and off-chain infrastructure rather than smart contract code itself.
